title: MindVault – Multi-User Personal Finance Ledger Platform
subtitle: Full-stack personal finance app with an immutable decimal-precise ledger, per-account roles and pre-aggregated analytics, built as a self-directed learning project.
description: Engineered a full-stack personal finance platform with an immutable, decimal-precise ledger, measured by 89 REST endpoints, 24 entities and 82 tests, via a NestJS/TypeORM API, pre-aggregated summaries and a Next.js client.

contribution.label: Solo Developer · Self-Learning Project
contribution.headline: Designed and built the entire platform alone, backend and frontend, to learn production-style NestJS, PostgreSQL and Next.js architecture.
scope: NestJS 11 backend: 11 modules, 22 controllers, 28 services, 24 TypeORM entities
Arbitrary-precision ledger engine and incremental summary pipeline
JWT, passkey and security-question auth with session tracking
Next.js 15 App Router client: 32 pages, 11 Zustand stores, 10 API services
Seeder CLI, Docker setup and 82 automated test cases
outOfScope: No production deployment or real end-users (learning project)

problem.statement: Personal finance tools suffer from floating-point balance drift, opaque balance edits, all-or-nothing sharing and dashboards that slow down as transaction history grows.

benefitMatrix.pain: Balances that drift or change without a trace
benefitMatrix.before: Floating-point arithmetic and in-place edits make reconciliation unreliable.
benefitMatrix.after: decimal.js arithmetic with non-negative balance checks and an append-only AccountLedger audit trail.

benefitMatrix.pain: Sharing means giving full access or duplicating accounts
benefitMatrix.before: A single global role applies to every account a user touches.
benefitMatrix.after: Per-account roles (Owner, Admin, Editor, Viewer) enforced by NestJS guards via AccountUserRole.

benefitMatrix.pain: Analytics slow down as history grows
benefitMatrix.before: Trend charts run SUM and GROUP BY scans over all transactions.
benefitMatrix.after: Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and category summaries updated transactionally on each write.

product.summary: A self-built, multi-user personal finance platform that keeps balances exact, edits auditable and sharing granular, with fast analytics from pre-aggregated summaries.
product.tagline: Exact balances, auditable history, per-account sharing.
product.problem: Personal finance tools suffer from floating-point balance drift, opaque balance edits, all-or-nothing sharing and dashboards that slow down as transaction history grows.

items.painDescription: Floating-point math and silent edits make balances hard to reconcile.
items.gainDescription: decimal.js math, non-negative checks and an append-only AccountLedger trail.

items.painDescription: Sharing with family means full access or duplicated accounts.
items.gainDescription: Owner, Admin, Editor and Viewer roles set per account, not globally.

items.painDescription: On-demand SUM and GROUP BY scans grow with every transaction.
items.gainDescription: Daily to yearly and category rollups updated on each write.

items.painDescription: Removing a tag or category erases historical context.
items.gainDescription: Hierarchical tag groups with full restore.

keyDecisions.challenge: JavaScript floating-point arithmetic makes account balances drift over repeated transactions.
keyDecisions.decision: Stored amounts as string/numeric values and wrapped all math in decimal.js helpers (safeAdd, safeSubtract) with non-negative balance checks. Trade-off: explicit type parsing across services and DTOs.
keyDecisions.outcome: Exact monetary arithmetic and no negative-balance underflow in ledger operations.

keyDecisions.challenge: Multi-interval trend queries need expensive SUM and GROUP BY scans as history grows.
keyDecisions.decision: Added dedicated summary entities (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, category) updated transactionally on create, update and delete. Trade-off: extra write-path work.
keyDecisions.outcome: Dashboards and comparisons read pre-aggregated rows instead of scanning raw transactions.

keyDecisions.challenge: Users need different permissions on different accounts (owner here, viewer on a family account).
keyDecisions.decision: Separated global authentication from account authorization with an AccountUserRole junction entity and custom NestJS guards. Trade-off: extra lookups on account-scoped requests.
keyDecisions.outcome: Strict per-account access without duplicating accounts or raising global privileges.

keyDecisions.challenge: Multi-entity client state and inconsistent API feedback caused prop drilling.
keyDecisions.decision: Split data access into 10 API services and state into 11 domain Zustand stores, with a global ApiResponseToast bridge. Trade-off: more store and service files.
keyDecisions.outcome: No prop drilling, isolated re-renders and uniform feedback on every mutation.

keyDecisions.challenge: Tagging needed soft delete and grouping without bloating controllers.
keyDecisions.decision: Dedicated repositories, validators and transformers for tags and tag groups. Trade-off: more classes per module.
keyDecisions.outcome: A decoupled tagging subsystem with recycle-bin restore.

securityReliability: JWT cookie and bearer authentication with bcrypt password hashing.
Passkey verification, security questions, active session tracking and password-reset logging.
Account-scoped RBAC guards (Owner, Admin, Editor, Viewer) on top of global authentication.
Non-negative balance enforcement in the decimal ledger engine.
82 automated test cases across 10 spec files (unit and e2e).
futureRoadmap: Financial statement export engine (PDF and CSV).
Personal growth suite: LifeLog, Contacts, Capsule reflection, Knowledge base, Micro Actions, Storyline.
